page.layout: One page of text in a single column. In the left margin, beside the heading "REGNUM MALABAR.", a section number "2.". Page number and running head at the top. No catchword or signature.

main_text.p: 4. Proprio caret nomine, cujus primus rex nomine Verido, natione Hungarus, A. C. 1510. obiit.
5. Vizapor, cujus rex dictus Mu-hadum Koja.
6. Goa[?], cujus primus Rex appel-latus fuit Sabeb Adelkan, i.e. Domi-nus, Rex justitiæ, ex quo Portugalli fecerunt Sabajo & Hidalkan.
main_text.head: 2.REGNUM MA-LABAR.
Canon.
Regnum Malabar divisum in varia Regna.
main_text.p: Regnum Malabar ante multa se-cula uni Monarchæ subjectum fuit, quorum ultimus Sarama Perymal circa A. C. 900, cùm liberis careret, regnum suum inter fidelissimos Ministrorum distribuit. vid. Scalig. de Emendat. temp. lib. 7. Ex his impe-rium

page.notes: The section number "2." stands in the left margin beside the heading and is recorded as a note. The faint mirrored text on the right margin is show-through and is left out. The "Goa" word is set in italic; the final letter is uncertain and is marked [?].
